slides.title: 3 red days in an uptrend. Buy the dip?
Trend filter: 50-day SMA
slides.text: Trade it only when price is above the **50-day SMA**: the trend is up.

slides.title: Wait for 3 lower closes
slides.text: Three closes in a row, each lower than the last. Entry on the third close: **104.80**.

slides.title: Stop: 1 ATR below the low
slides.text: The pullback's low minus one ATR: **103.58**. Risk: **1.22**.

slides.title: Exit on the first strong close
slides.text: A close above the previous day's high: **106.47**, about **1.4R**.

points.t: Then a dip is often just the trend going down.
That can be a real repricing, not a pullback.
That's exactly what the stop is for.

slides.title: Buy weakness only inside strength.
slides.text: The trend filter does the heavy lifting. **No uptrend, no trade.**

post.instagram:
A pullback strategy in 4 steps: 1) only when price is above the 50-day SMA, 2) wait for three lower closes in a row and enter on the third, 3) stop at the pullback's low minus one ATR, 4) exit on the first close above the previous day's high. Example: entry 104.80, stop 103.58, exit 106.47, about 1.4R.
